# Authoritative list of CircleCI status-check contexts that MUST be required by
# the branch protection on main. One context per line; blank lines and #
# comments are ignored.
#
# NOTHING IS REQUIRED TODAY. This repository has no repository-level ruleset:
# the only rulesets that apply to it are the enterprise-sourced
# stable-branch-no-force-push and stable-branch-no-delete, and neither carries
# a required_status_checks rule. So every gate below runs, reports, and blocks
# nothing at merge time. Creating the ruleset is an org-owner action; this file
# is what it should be created from.
#
# The required-checks-drift job compares this list against the live branch
# rules for main and reports any context that is committed but not required (a
# gate that does not block a merge) or required but not committed (a required
# context nothing emits is fail-closed and blocks every merge; one that matches
# the WRONG job silently drops the intended gate). That job is WARN-ONLY until
# the ruleset exists; flip it to blocking in the same change that creates it.
#
# WHY THESE STRINGS ARE STABLE NOW. CircleCI appends an instance suffix when the
# same job name appears in more than one workflow, and the scheme is not
# predictable. This repo has already been bitten: dependency-cve-scan ran
# unnamed in both the ci and nightly workflows and reported as
# "ci/circleci: dependency-cve-scan-1". Every gate instance now carries an
# explicit `name:` in .circleci/config.yml (bare in the ci workflow, -nightly in
# the nightly one), so no future topology change can renumber them.
#
# Verify after any topology change with either of:
#   circleci config process .circleci/config.yml
#   gh pr checks <PR>
# The second is the authoritative confirmation.

# Dependency CVEs in Cargo.lock, fixable CRITICAL/HIGH, waivers subtracted at
# gate time, Cargo.lock asserted present by name
ci/circleci: dependency-cve-scan

# SAST tier 1: full repo, p/default plus p/rust, ERROR band
ci/circleci: sast-scan

# SAST tier 2: newly introduced findings only, WARNING band
ci/circleci: sast-scan-diff

# Waiver and disposition integrity: undated, expired, over-window or
# unattributed accepted risks, and any shrinkage of SAST scope
ci/circleci: disposition-check

# Existing functional gates, listed so the ruleset is created complete rather
# than security-only
ci/circleci: lint-python
ci/circleci: lint-rust
ci/circleci: test-rust
ci/circleci: test-python-310-single-3.12
ci/circleci: test-python-310-cluster-3.12
ci/circleci: test-python-313-single-3.12
ci/circleci: test-python-313-cluster-3.12

# NOT REQUIRED YET, deliberately:
#   ci/circleci: secret-scan
#     Report-only for one enumeration cycle with .circleci/trivy-secret.yaml in
#     place, so genuine fixtures get dated allow-rules before the gate can go
#     red. docker/server.pem is an open finding, not an allow-rule. Add this
#     line in the same change that sets fail-on-findings: true on the job.
#   ci/circleci: dockerfile-scan
#     The misconfig half is report-only until DS-0015 and DS-0029 are fixed on
#     the builder images; see the flip criterion on the job. The credential
#     guard inside it is already blocking.
#   ci/circleci: required-checks-drift
#     Warn-only by construction; requiring a check that can never fail adds no
#     protection.
